question: Can a cold-restored library of native source-trained numeric causal functions make accurate predictions in unseen relabeled action-context worlds from only 16 witnessed target interventions, without donor identity or transformation labels? Can the same method reject unknown quartic changes?
hypothesis: Read-only analogical source retrieval using cold native checkpoints and a predeclared permutation family improves held transfer-composition Brier over target-only fully observed native and conventional GF(2) controls. It is expected to tie an identical conventional Bayesian analogy and cannot demonstrate scientific superiority.
world: 5 observed context bits + one binary intervention action. Three unknown source causal functions each include affine, quadratic and cubic structure. Three new in-family target functions are generated from hidden donor identity, a context-bit permutation, context input XOR mask and optional output complement (action bit remains unchanged); three target OOD functions also contain an independent quartic term. The hidden donor, permutation, mask, complement and OOD label never go to model training, decision or forecast.
input_design: For each original pilot, select 42 linearly independent source input indices using only public degree3 features, observe 42 genuine source consequences per donor (3 donors). Independently shuffle 64 target public input IDs without using outcomes; observe 10 target fit consequences and six additional source-only calibration consequences, reserve next 16 held unseen actions for evaluation, 32 other target inputs unused.
candidate: Train unchanged NativeContextAccumulator on three donor slots from source-only 42 witnesses; cold restore checkpoint; enumerate exactly 3 donors x 5! context permutations x 32 context-XOR masks x 2 output flips =23040 possible causal analogies for each target. Condition on 10 source-only target fit witnesses then six separate witnessed calibration outcomes; read cold native predictions ONLY, never program hypothesized outcomes into native weights. Mean of compatible hypotheses at held inputs, abstain 0.5 when none. Donor identity and transformation unknown to this readout. Candidate is a conventional analogy wrapper around native stored functions, NOT a native inbuilt transfer mechanism.
controls: An independent full conventional analogical posterior using GF(2) fitted donor tables, identical 23040 candidates and exact 10+6 target witnesses; parity compulsory; strong conventional baseline.
Unmodified NativeCumulativeLearner on each target slot with all 16 witnessed target inputs, no donor knowledge.
Independent conventional full-degree3 GF(2) source-only target fit with 16 witnessed target inputs, abstain when input not identified.
Fully fitted degree3 polynomial logistic on all 16 target witnesses, smoothed action frequency, 0.5 sham.
Uncalibrated analogical readout after only 10 target fit witnesses (6 calibration outcomes are not used by this arm)

Three non-isomorphic quartic-shift targets with identical 10+6 source budget; cold exact donor checkpoint, full 64-input retention and sibling conflict atomicity after four independent pressure slots.
budgets: Per seed three donors x42=126 source records; six targets x(10+6)=96; four pressure slots x42=168; 390 source consequences in total. Held: 16 held action inputs per target, three target slots per family, two families, three public composition graphs =96 held composites per seed. Two original pilot seeds only, no repeated first-use on error. Source matching must use identical public actions/outcomes; all held truth evaluator only.
threshold: Both seeds: in-family transfer held composite Brier <=0.08; >=0.05 better than both target-only native and target-only conventional full degree3 GF2; exact Brier parity with independent conventional analogue <=1e-10; calibrated Brier <= uncalibrated; >=50% held primitive forecasts with confidence >=0.90 (or <=0.10) and zero incorrect committed primitive predictions. For OOD: >=2/3 quartic slots with zero compatible hypotheses after 10+6 calibration; zero incorrect confidently accepted OOD primitive forecasts, calibrated OOD Brier <= uncalibrated. Cold byte checksum/64 input retention, exact source budgets, no hypothetical outcome writes, and conflict atomicity PASS. Else SCREEN_NO_GO; invalid source/control/cold classified INVALID.
scientific_boundary: Even if all thresholds pass, ENGINEERING_FEASIBLE only. Exact conventional Bayesian analogy uses the same donor/target evidence and known transformation class; there can be no SCIENTIFIC_PASS or evidence of open-world relational learning. More challenging independent unfamiliar families with no supplied transformation space and matched fully trained baselines are required.
compute: GitHub hosted CPU, Python 3.12 pinned numpy/scipy/scikit-learn; no paid API, GPU, private runner, owner loop, live action. Full exact-source Linux and Windows final regression on result candidate. Original read-only independent auditor reconstructs metrics and action budgets from byte-pinned Git evidence.
source_lock: Commit prereg before source, lock exact source Git blob prior to original pilot first-use. Preserve results, frozen decision, primary seeds unconsumed; no replay of consumed pilots, no postresult code/threshold tuning.
